subject: Packaging check: retention buckets, trace sampling credits, and dashboard seat packs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Owens <michael.owens@veloxhealth.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@veloxhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging check: retention buckets, trace sampling credits, and dashboard seat packs

Hi Michael and Sara,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to learn more about VeloxHealth's telemetry growth. I promised a quick note outlining the packaging options we discussed so you can share with the procurement team. High-level:

- Retention: tiered buckets (30d/90d/365d) priced per GB-month with a step discount at commit thresholds.
- Tracing: a base sampling allowance plus purchaseable sampling credits that apply to spans over the allowance. Credits are consumed and prorated monthly.
- Dashboards: seat packs (5-seat, 20-seat, 50-seat) with a per-seat rate and a small seat-management fee.

I attached a workbook that maps common usage profiles to cost estimates. Two quick questions for you before I formalize a SOW:
1) Do you plan to keep full 365d retention for all environments or only prod?
2) Will tracing sampling be applied uniformly, or do you want per-service policies (which affects credit burn estimates)?

If you want, we can run a short billing-scenario table for your Q4 forecast.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Velox-Retention-Workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Michael Owens <michael.owens@veloxhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging check: retention buckets, trace sampling credits, and dashboard seat packs

Marissa,

Thanks — the workbook is helpful. Quick answers:
- We want 365d retention for prod; non-prod can be 90d.
- We'll start with uniform sampling but may add per-service rules later (we're instrumenting a new payments service next month).

Two asks from procurement: 1) can you show a blended price if we commit to 12 months at the 50-seat pack + 2TB retention bucket? 2) is there a way to convert unused sampling credits into a usage buffer for the next month?

Appreciate it — will loop in procurement if you send a draft SOW.

Best,
Michael
VP Engineering, VeloxHealth

Ben / Karthik,

VELox (VeloxHealth) wants a blended price example: 12-month commit, 50-seat pack + 2TB retention (prod 365d, non-prod 90d). Procurement also asked if unused sampling credits can roll forward. I've attached the workbook — see Michael's note below.

Can you advise:
- Best concession we can offer on the 50-seat pack if they commit 12 months?
- Policy on sampling-credit rollover — current product supports consumption-only, but is there an accepted commercial concession (e.g., convert up to 20% unused credits to a one-time month-of buffer)?

Need numbers to feed into the draft SOW by EOD tomorrow.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging check: retention buckets, trace sampling credits, and dashboard seat packs — pricing ask

Marissa, Karthik,

Numbers (quick back-of-envelope):
- 50-seat pack (12m commit): list $X/seat -> we can give 18% off at that commit level plus waive the seat-management fee for first 6 months.
- 2TB retention (12m commit): step discount yields ~12% effective discount versus pay-as-you-go.
- Sampling credits: product does not natively roll credits forward; commercially, we can offer a one-time safety buffer equal to 10% of their monthly allowance for the first 3 months (non-renewing). That preserves expected economics while giving procurement headroom.

If they push for roll-forward as a contract term, flag Legal — that's higher risk. Otherwise this concession should be easy to document in SOW.

I can make a line-item price table for the SOW.

-Ben

Ben Carter
